Okay, the wait is over and it's time... Time to release this month's new public short story... Latex Tribe! A very interesting story that I really enjoyed writing. Join our three female soldiers as they venture deep into the jungle in search of the reason behind some disappearances in the area... The motive? A mysterious tribe that will see three new recruits among these soldiers...
